Annotation

Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us
The patient shows hypoxemia, mild anemia, leukopenia, mild thrombocytopenia, elevated RDW, high ferritin, and markedly elevated CRP, suggesting significant inflammation. INR is elevated, indicating coagulopathy. Basophils are slightly increased. Liver and renal function, cardiac markers, and electrolytes are within normal limits. Findings are consistent with acute systemic inflammation, possible infection or inflammatory process, and risk of bleeding; clinical correlation and further evaluation are recommended.
